title: Net Webhook
description: Data payload for msg_type 'webhook'. Carries an inbound HTTP webhook request received by the omos-bridge network ingress, including method, headers, and body.

source_url.description: Full URL of the inbound webhook request.

method.description: HTTP method of the inbound request.

headers.description: HTTP request headers as key-value string pairs (header names lowercased).

body_raw.description: Raw request body as a UTF-8 string. Null if the request had no body.

body_parsed.description: JSON-parsed request body if Content-Type was application/json. Null otherwise.

received_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the webhook was received.
